assets.prompt: Original Chinese first-grade picture book, fine paper grain, matte gouache, layered paper-cut style, clear friendly silhouettes. Deep pine green and warm cream, persimmon and apricot accents, soft blue for shadows. No written characters, digits, symbols that resemble writing, watermarks, brands, banners with text, or borrowed book illustration. Make each cell fully independent, exact straight grid divisions, bold subjects and generous safe padding. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 equal near-square panels. Same friendly brown bear messenger with teal scarf, soft rounded striped orange tiger, bright orange fox, soft charcoal gray wolf, and tan white-spotted little sika deer, all distinct. Row 1 left to right: 1 friendly tiger calmly asks bear to tell others about a meeting, beside a small forest announcement booth and unlettered scroll; 2 bear first calls with a cream and orange megaphone on small tree-stump stage, no time props; 3 fox clearly looks at bear and raises one paw to ask a question, daytime forest; 4 bear returns to tiger, tiger raises one paw to indicate the next day, both looking toward a simple blank flip calendar. Row 2: 1 bear calls another announcement beside an undetailed flip-calendar, no clock; 2 gray wolf asks bear something, his paw points toward an analog wrist watch on his own wrist; 3 tiger sets a small blank analog round clock with hands and no digits, pale sun behind; 4 bear calls into megaphone alongside an open calendar and tiny timepiece, audience not shown. Row 3: 1 clearly spotted deer raises a hoof, looks at bear and glances between two forest pathways as if asking where; 2 tiger raises a paw to his forehead realizing something was forgotten, forest backdrop; 3 bear speaks final complete message into megaphone, cheerful, notices attached near a wooden placard without letters; 4 the animal friends bear, fox, wolf, deer and tiger gathered together at an open forest clearing with low circular wooden stage and pine trees, sunny morning. Row 4: 1 clear standalone circular forest plaza with low wooden dais and surrounding pines, no characters; 2 a school child reading a simple hand-made notice to a friend at a crafts table with paper and leaves, no marks; 3 simple smiling orange megaphone on a rounded warm-cream sticker with pine trim, centered on pale mint; 4 fox and wolf listening closely to a friend, neutral for role reading. Keep animals' moods gentle and each picture easy to distinguish.
